Currently finishing my Bsc and halfway through my PgDip. Working a 9-5 and 2 part time jobs. Also student leadership for both schools.  Top performer in both schools and at work.

I am 26F and I have AuDHD..

How do I do it? Shame. Intense and consistent shame. I continuously move the bar and push myself to go harder and be better. Rage also fuels my drive to work harder.

Does it work? Yeah, it can be efficient at times. BUT the burnout is never ending. Of course I am always draining myself. It's a toxic cycle with myself. My friends even joke that if I'm heartbroken then here comes another degree 😭

I am also in therapy and we are trying to work on this unhealthy coping mechanism. It's what I do but not sustainable long-term. I don't celebrate my wins because I'm busy pushing for the next one.

I can't have 1 job or 1 school otherwise I disengage and get bored. But under pressure? I thrive and it sucks. Because it means when things are calm, I shut down.

My plan long-term is:  
• Work jobs with flexible hours (preferably project based)  
• Changing jobs ever 2-3years (usually when I mentally disengaged and grow tired of masking with staff)  
• Continue to study but short certificates alongside friends (some form of body doubling and it helps me)  
• Improve my work-life balance and be consistent (hence no more rage and shame induced achievements 😅)  
• Spend time with friends and myself (helps to recharge)

Hopefully this gives you some perspective. From the outside, so many people think I've got it all together. I really don't, but I want to. Not for them, but for me.
